title: BAOS: Benchmark-Aware Objective Selection toolbox and reproduction code
description: MATLAB/GNU Octave toolbox implementing the Benchmark Objective Independence Test (BOIT), together with the complete code, results and scripts that reproduce every table and figure of the article 'When does a benchmark-relative objective change the optimum? Theory and a resolution-aware independence test for multi-objective design' (submitted to Structural and Multidisciplinary Optimization).
